请求区间内没有返回数据，请核对合约和时间范围。: No data was returned for this interval. Check the contract and time range.
下载完成不代表交易时段完整；数据保留原始来源，不混合不同数据商。: Completed downloads do not certify session coverage. Datasets retain their source and are never mixed across providers.
结构与摘要已校验；交易时段覆盖未校验: Structure and digest verified; session coverage not verified
为研究积累可追溯的合约历史数据: Build traceable contract history for research
自动下载该合约完整存续期；未到期合约截至本次查询时刻。: Download the contract's full lifetime, capped at this lookup time for active contracts.
没有找到月份合约，请检查交易所和品种代码。: No dated contracts found. Check the exchange and product code.
选择具体月份合约，自动下载整个存续期的分钟数据。需要合约资料与分钟数据权限。: Select a dated contract to download its full minute-data history. Contract metadata and minute-data entitlements are required.
此范围没有记录；不能据此判定缺失或无成交。: No records in this range. This does not distinguish missing data from no trading.
清单与已读取分段的摘要、时间顺序、重复时间戳及 OHLC 关系已校验。: Manifest and loaded chunks verified for checksums, time order, duplicate timestamps and OHLC consistency.
未校验交易日历完整性；缺失、休市与无成交尚不能自动区分。: Trading-calendar completeness is not verified. Missing data, closed sessions and no trading cannot yet be distinguished automatically.
价格与数量保留精确原值；图表仅用于可视化。: Prices and quantities retain exact values; charts are for visualization only.
图表操作提示: Arrow keys inspect records; + / − zoom; drag or Shift + arrows pan; End follows the latest. Loaded records only; closed sessions are not filled.
历史数据服务未连接，查询暂不可用。: Historical data service is disconnected. Queries are unavailable.
已加载的图表与记录仍可查看。: Loaded charts and records remain available.
返回的数据与所选数据集不匹配: The returned data does not match the selected dataset.
历史下载当前使用本机研究服务。: Historical downloads currently use the local research service.
选择具体月份合约，下载存续期内按交易日期记录的日线。需要合约资料与日线数据权限。: Choose a dated futures contract to download daily bars by trading date across its lifetime. Contract catalog and daily data access are required.
清单与日线分段摘要、交易日期顺序及 OHLC 关系已校验。: Manifest and daily segment hashes, trading date order and OHLC relationships have been validated.
保留数据源原始字段；合约乘数与每手交易单位不自动互换，缺失值不推算。: Original provider fields: contract multiplier and units per lot are not interchangeable. Missing values are not inferred.
历史仓库说明: Published revisions are immutable and isolated by contract, source and interval. An empty download does not prove complete market coverage.
请在设置中重新输入连接凭据。: Re-enter the connection credential in Settings.
为每个月份合约各建一个下载任务，每个合约下载完整存续期。最多同时运行 2 个任务: Creates one download per contract month, each covering its whole life. At most two run at once, each at half the request limit.
按品种核对覆盖，请先填写品种: Enter a product to check its coverage
按合约统计仓库中分钟线与日线覆盖的交易日；缺失交易日是分钟线起止范围内、日线有而: Trading days covered by archived minute and daily data per contract. Missing days are daily trading days within the minute range that have no minute bars. Every file digest is verified first.
Token 用于合约查询与本机下载；任务提交后清空输入。任务凭据由当前账户保护。: The token is used for contract lookup and local downloads, then cleared after submission. Task credentials are protected by your account.
按固定版本分别核对分钟线与日线，不合并来源、周期或版本。这里只检查整日缺口，不代: Compare exact minute and daily versions without merging sources, intervals or revisions. This checks missing whole days, not intraday completeness.
按这两个固定版本核对整日缺口；为保留夜盘边界，将重新下载原始请求时段。数据源不保: Compare whole trading days in these two fixed versions. Re-download the original request window to preserve night-session boundaries. The source may still return missing records.
从所选版本结束处继续，最多下载到已结束的日期；不会自动合并其他下载或更改已保存数: Continue from the end of this version through a completed calendar day. Other downloads and saved datasets are not changed automatically.
生成独立数据版本，原文件保持不变。完成后先检查数据，再用于研究。: Creates a separate version and preserves the original files. Inspect the result before using it for research.
下载任务已提交，可在历史数据页查看进度。: Download submitted. Follow its progress on the history page.
本次下载未完成，请在历史数据页查看原因或重试。: This download did not finish. Check the history page for details or retry.
找到 {count} 条关联记录，请保留此版本。: Found {count} linked records. Retain this version.
当前研究服务中未发现关联记录；这不代表该版本可以删除。: No linked records were found in this research service. This does not mean the version can be deleted.
包含来源下载、回测、K 线因子、日线因子和已保存数据集；任务结束或取消后仍保留来: Includes source downloads, backtests, bar factors, daily factors and saved datasets. Completed and cancelled tasks retain their source references.
研究服务检查未完成，不能视为无引用。: Research service inspection is incomplete; this does not mean there are no references.
本机账本已检查；服务保持停止。: Local ledger inspected; the service remains stopped.
以下已登记节点未连接，本次未检查；不会自动连接或启动服务。: These registered nodes are disconnected and were not inspected. No connections or services are started automatically.
节点登记清单未能完整读取，检查范围不完整。: The registered node list could not be read completely; inspection coverage is incomplete.
检查已连接节点的任务与已保存数据集；停止的本机服务只读检查账本。: Inspect tasks and saved datasets on connected nodes; stopped local service ledgers are read only.
核对研究记录和本窗口草稿。尚未开放历史版本删除。: Checks research records and this window's drafts. Deleting historical versions is not available yet.
未检查停止的远程研究服务、未连接的节点及其他窗口的研究草稿。结果是本次查询的观察: Stopped remote research services, disconnected nodes and drafts in other windows are not checked. The result is an observation of this query, not permission to delete; a failed check must not be treated as no reference.
日线保存供应商交易日期与结算价，可作为研究的 K 线或结算价来源；不补造缺失的交: Daily bars keep the vendor's trading dates and settlement prices and can serve research as bars or settlement prices. Missing trading days are not fabricated.
分钟数据按 K 线结束时间保存，交易日来自交易所交易日历，可用于研究。不补造缺失: Minute bars are stored by bar end time, with trading days from the exchange calendar, and can be used for research. Missing bars and continuous contracts are not fabricated.
